camel_example: aliyun eci DescribeAvailableResource --region cn-hangzhou --DestinationResource.Memory '4.0' --DestinationResource.Category InstanceTypeFamily --DestinationResource.Value 'ecs.c6' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --DestinationResource.Cores '2.0' --method POST --force
description_en: Queries the ECS instance families available for sale in a specified region and zone
description_zh: 调用DescribeAvailableResource查询指定地域和可用区下可售ECS实例规格族
kebab_example: aliyun eci describe-available-resource --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --destination-resource Cores=2.0 Category=InstanceTypeFamily Memory=4.0 Value=ecs.c6 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeAvailableResource

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/146965.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/146965.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The zone ID.

Default value: empty. If this parameter is left empty, all zones in the specified region are queried
parameters.help_zh:
可用区ID。

默认值为空，此时查询指定地域下的所有可用区
parameters.name: zone_id

fields.help_en:
The resource type. Valid values:

InstanceTypeFamily: queries instance families. Use this value together with Value.
InstanceType: queries instance types. Use this value together with Value, Cores, and Memory
fields.help_zh:
资源类型。取值范围：

InstanceTypeFamily：表示查询实例规格族，配合Value使用。
InstanceType：表示查询实例规格，配合Value，以及Cores和Memory使用
fields.name: category

fields.help_en: The number of vCPUs. This parameter can be specified when Category is set to InstanceType
fields.help_zh: vCPU核数。当Category取值为InstanceType时，可以设置
fields.name: cores

fields.help_en: The memory size. Unit: GiB. This parameter can be specified when Category is set to InstanceType
fields.help_zh: 内存大小。单位为GiB。当Category取值为InstanceType时，可以设置
fields.name: memory

fields.help_en:
The instance family or specific instance type.

If Category is set to InstanceTypeFamily, set this parameter to an instance family, such as ecs.c5.
If Category is set to InstanceType, set this parameter to a specific instance type, such as ecs.c5.large
fields.help_zh:
实例规格族或者具体实例规格。

当Category取值为InstanceTypeFamily时，取值为实例规格族，如ecs.c5。
当Category取值为InstanceType时，取值为具体实例规格。如ecs.c5.large
fields.name: value

fields.help_en: The protection period of the spot instance. Unit: hours. Default value: 1. Set the value to 0 to indicate no protection period
fields.help_zh: 抢占式实例的保护期。单位为小时。默认为1。可设置为0，表示无保护期
fields.name: spot_duration

fields.help_en: The maximum hourly price of the spot instance. The value can be accurate to three decimal places. This parameter is required when SpotStrategy is set to SpotWithPriceLimit
fields.help_zh: 抢占式实例的每小时最高价格，最多精确到小数点后3位。当SpotStrategy取值为SpotWithPriceLimit时，必须设置SpotPriceLimit
fields.name: spot_price_limit

fields.help_en:
The bidding policy for the instance. Valid values:

NoSpot: a pay-as-you-go instance.
SpotWithPriceLimit: a spot instance with a maximum hourly price.
SpotAsPriceGo: a spot instance that is billed based on the market price at the time of purchase.

Default value: NoSpot.

When you query spot instance resource information (that is, when the value is SpotWithPriceLimit or SpotAsPriceGo), Category must be set to InstanceType, and you must specify a specific instance type (Value) or specify vCPUs and memory (Cores and Memory)
fields.help_zh:
实例的抢占策略。取值范围：

NoSpot：正常按量付费实例。
SpotWithPriceLimit：设置上限价格的抢占式实例。
SpotAsPriceGo：系统自动出价，跟随当前市场实际价格的抢占式实例。

默认为：NoSpot。

查询抢占式实例资源信息时，即取值为SpotWithPriceLimit或SpotAsPriceGo时，Category取值必须为InstanceType，同时需指定具体实例规格（Value），或者指定vCPU和内存（Cores和Memory）
fields.name: spot_strategy

parameters.help_en: The resource information of the spot instance to query
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的抢占式实例的资源信息
parameters.name: spot_resource
